title: Ad 1 — Cryptographic SHA-256 & Ed25519 Security (Tamper Alarms)
angle: Physical paper stacks and unverified Word files vs. cryptographic per-block Merkle integrity

🛡️ The era of unverified paper mountains and easily forged digital documents is over.

Anyone can unzip a Microsoft Word (.docx) file, modify financial clauses in raw XML, and Word will open it without warning. In legal and enterprise workflows, that is a catastrophic vulnerability.

The Living Document Format (.ldocx) re-engineers document security with mathematical rigor:
🔒 Per-block SHA-256 Merkle tree hashing
🔑 Ed25519 cryptographic signatures
🚨 Tamper detection alarms that trigger in under 15ms
📦 Zero macros, zero arbitrary scripts, 100% offline verification

Verify document authenticity in 3 lines of code:
const { LDOCXParser } = require('ldoc-sdk');
const doc = await LDOCXParser.parse(buffer);
console.log(doc.verifyIntegrity() ? 'Authentic' : 'Tampered');
